knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Sterile packs and medicine stock are clean-zone items. The other three are contaminated or soiled and belong in the contaminated area.
Mandatory signs state an action that must be taken. Prohibition signs say what must not happen, danger signs warn of a hazard, and general information signs give neutral information.
Keeping used items apart from sterile stock stops contamination from spreading. The other options are not the reason the guide gives.

practicalCriteria: Given an area plan, the learner marks clean and soiled spaces and places five listed items correctly without prompts.
Given a scenario with a soiled item and a clean store, the learner routes each item correctly and changes gloves before entry.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Assessor observation of zone sorting and routing on a workplace plan or simulation
Record of a sign report made during the simulation
stopWorkCriteria: Soiled material is about to pass into a clean store, or clean stock is about to be set down in a soiled space: stop and re-route.
A hazard sign is missing or unreadable in an area the worker has to enter: stop and report before entering.
